transforms.result:
{$t('messages.title')}

{#if showModal}

{$t('messages.start_new_message')}

{$t('messages.enter_pubkey')}

{$t('messages.enter_npub')}

{#if newMessageError}
{newMessageError}
{/if} {#if isProfileLoading}
{:else if newMessageProfile}

{newMessageProfile.name || 'Unknown User'}

{newMessagePubkey.startsWith('npub') ? `${newMessagePubkey.slice(0, 16)}...` : `${newMessagePubkey.slice(0, 8)}...`}

{:else if newMessagePubkey && !newMessageError}

{$t('messages.no_profile_found')}

{newMessagePubkey.startsWith('npub') ? `${newMessagePubkey.slice(0, 16)}...` : `${newMessagePubkey.slice(0, 8)}...`}

{/if}
{/if}
{#if conversations.length > 0}
{/if}
{#if isLoading}
{#each Array(5) as _}
{/each}
{:else if error}
{error}
{:else if conversations.length === 0}

{$t('messages.no_messages')}

{$t('messages.start_conversation')}

{:else if filteredConversations.length === 0}

{$t('messages.no_conversations_found')}

{$t('messages.try_different_search')}

{:else}
{#each filteredConversations as conversation} {/each}
{/if}
